title: PR #104: fix(explorer): resolve TypeScript/ts-jest dependency conflict
content:
State: closed
Merged: True
Draft: False

## Summary
- Align the explorer TypeScript dependency with the `ts-jest@29` peer range (`>=4.3 <7`) and update its lockfile to TypeScript 6.0.3.
- Repair the SDK workspace lockfiles so declared `typescript` workspaces are represented in lockfile v3.
- Align the canonical ATC SDK TypeScript compiler dependency with the locked TypeScript 6.0.3 toolchain.

## Evidence
Workflow run `37852262191`, job `113567839472`, failed because `typescript@7.0.2` conflicts with `ts-jest@29.4.14` (`typescript >=4.3 <7`). The same run also showed `npm ci` fallback failures for SDK workspace roots whose lockfiles did not record their workspace packages.

## Verification status
Manifest/lockfile consistency was checked through GitHub file reads. A fresh CI run is still required to establish VERIFIED status. No merge performed.
